rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for a formal school or university test.

example.english: I have an examination tomorrow, so I need to study tonight.
example.traditional: 我聽日要考試，今晚要溫書。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 haau2 si5 gam1 maan1 jiu3 wan1 syu1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a medical check-up or examination.

example.english: The company arranged a medical examination for us next week.
example.traditional: 公司安排咗我哋下星期去驗身。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 on1 paai4 zo2 ngo5 dei6 haa6 sing1 kei4 heoi3 jim6 san1

rows.note: Use this for a general inspection or checking process rather than a medical check-up or formal test.

example.english: Do a careful examination of the contract before signing it.
example.traditional: 你查清楚份合約先好簽。
example.jyutping: nei5 caa4 cing1 co2 fan6 hap6 joek3 sin1 hou2 cim1
